free_tier.stated: The 1 GB plan with 1 core and 30 GB NVMe is JPY 750 a month on a one-month term, JPY 671 on a twelve-month term and JPY 451 on a thirty-six-month term, with no setup fee. The vendor raised every plan on 2026-09-01: the 1 GB month-to-month price went from JPY 540 to 750, a rise of about 39 percent, and the 2 GB plan from 750 to 1,040.

retention.stated: The minimum term is three months and the vendor runs no trial, so a one-month experiment costs three months of the monthly rate; the term floor, not the price, is what a short job cannot fit into.

record.chaining: Shin VPS is the cleanest evidence among documented hosts that the Japanese floor moved: the same 1 GB box that cost JPY 540 in August cost JPY 750 in October, which is a 39 percent rise in two months, and the annual term is now the only way back below JPY 700.
